speed_result: stable at all tested no-load points; no voltage saturation observed
feedforward_result: small difference at low and medium speed; slight high-speed benefit, not yet a strong conclusion
position_result: the first +2 degree step showed a sustained approximately +/-1.3 degree oscillation with approximately +/-25 rpm; later -2, +5 and return-to-zero steps were comparatively stable
limitations: Results apply only to the tested firmware and no-load setup
